sloka: राम लक्ष्मणयो राजन् गो दानम् कारयस्व ह ।पितृ कार्यम् च भद्रम् ते ततो वैवाहिकम् कुरु ॥१-७१-२३॥
transliteration: rāma lakṣmaṇayo rājan go dānam kārayasva ha ।pitṛ kāryam ca bhadram te tato vaivāhikam kuru ॥1-71-23॥

translations.english: O Delight of the Raghus (King Dasaratha), I offer these brides with immense pleasure to Rama and Lakshmana. You may perform the rites for your forefathers by gift of cows. Prosperity to you. Thereafter you may perform the marriage.
